name: av_income_statement
description:
Income statements (revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EBITDA and other line items) for one company from Alpha Vantage (INCOME_STATEMENT).
Returns: {symbol, annualReports: [...], quarterlyReports: [...]}, each report with fiscalDateEnding, reportedCurrency and the line items as strings.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker). Annual and quarterly reports both come back; there is no period filter.
Related: av_balance_sheet, av_cash_flow; other sources: yf_income_statement, openbb_income_statement.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM"}
